english: Remember— According to you, The habit of a pleasure being To see things as real Could never ever change; And the habit of their Lesser cousin To see things as real Could never ever change. And don't forget— Even according to you, A single being Who was at the same time Both a pleasure being And the lower cousin Of that being Is an utter impossibility. Between hours and between lifetimes, we are very different people.  If though reality is coming at us instead of from us, that part of reality should never change—and so there's no reason to think that our habit of perceiving it as coming from its own side should ever waver.  If we happen to be a pleasure being and think of ourselves as one, then there's no reason why that should ever change into being one of the lesser pleasure beings, and thinking of ourselves as one.  No one would ever be reborn, and there would be no Wheel of Life.
